name: All-Six Record Composition and Propagation

theorems.name: Exact all-six transfer
theorems.statement: C' >= P^* C P and L' = A L P imply K' <= A K A^*.

theorems.name: Defective all-six transfer
theorems.statement: L' = A L P + R with R C'^dagger R^* <= E_B implies K' <= (1+t) A K A^* + (1+t^-1) E_B.

theorems.name: All-six record composition
theorems.statement: A composed membrane is accepted iff all six channels compose and accumulated defects fit the terminal budget.

theorems.name: Summable-defect propagation
theorems.statement: K_{j+1} <= (1+eps_j)K_j + D_j with product and sum control gives uniform membrane budget.

nonclaims: public shadow transfer does not imply intrinsic membrane
matrix transfer without channel records is support-only
non-summable predictive defects do not yield a formed predictive membrane
